fit.description: Sample Co. is hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to own the design and reliability of our core platform. You will build and scale high-throughput services in Go and Python on AWS, own services end to end including on-call, lead incident response and postmortems, lead projects across teams and mentor engineers. Experience with LLM tooling (MCP, RAG, evals) is a plus.

role_facts: Yes: the headcount is approved and funded, and we're interviewing this month.
